Name: Valley Yaps
Author: RhanCandia
Description:
Valley Yaps brings Pelican Town to life by replacing generic NPC silence with dynamic, AI-powered chatter.

In vanilla Stardew Valley, talking to a villager after their daily scripted lines gives nothing or generic one-liners. Valley Yaps hooks into dialogue interactions so that once daily dialogue is exhausted, the NPC will continue conversing using an AI backend.

It works out-of-the-box with Google Gemini (free API key), as well as local offline AI tools like Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or custom OpenAI-compatible servers.

Each NPC stays in character with prompt context awareness, factoring in their personality, friendship hearts with the farmer, current season, in-game time, location, and family relationships.


AI Use & Content Disclosure
- Human-Directed Design: The code architecture, prompt templates, lore integration, dialogue filters, and game hooks were all intentionally designed and directed by a human developer to respect the spirit and aesthetic of Stardew Valley.
- Preserves Handcrafted Dialogue: This mod never replaces or overrides ConcernedApe's canonical daily dialogue. It only triggers when an NPC has completely exhausted their vanilla dialogue queue for the day.
- Player Choice & Privacy: Dialogue is generated at runtime through your own chosen provider (Google Gemini API with your own private key, or 100% locally and offline via Ollama/llama.cpp). No private data is logged or sent to third parties.


Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or higher): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. (Recommended) Install Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098
3. Download Valley Yaps from the Files tab.
4. Unzip the archive and place the ValleyYaps folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.
5. Launch the game using SMAPI!


How to Set Up Google Gemini (Easiest & Free but has rate limiting)
Valley Yaps is configured for Google Gemini by default. You only need a free API key:

Step 1: Get a free Gemini API key
1. Go to Google AI Studio: https://aistudio.google.com/
2. Sign in with your Google account.
3. Click "Get API key" (top left / top right).
4. Click "Create API key" and copy the key (starts with "AIzaSy...").

Step 2: Add your key in-game
- Using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM):
  Click the gear icon on the Stardew Valley title screen or in-game options menu -> select "Valley Yaps" -> paste your key into the "API Key" field -> Save.
- Or by editing config.json:
  Open Stardew Valley/Mods/ValleyYaps/config.json and set "ApiKey": "YOUR_KEY_HERE".

That's it! Talk to any villager twice in-game to start chatting.


Local AI Setup (Optional, unlimited generations)
If you prefer running AI offline locally on your own computer:
- Ollama: Run "ollama run llama3.2" in your terminal, then set Provider to "ollama" in GMCM.
- llama.cpp / LM Studio: Start your local server, then set Provider to "llama.cpp" in GMCM.


Main features
- In-Character Dialogue Generation: NPCs reply with sentences matching their lore, personality, and relationship level with your farmer.
- Context-Aware Prompts: Prompts dynamically inject the villager's name, personality traits, date, time of day, location, and friendship heart count.
- Zero-Friction Provider Selection: Built-in support for Gemini (default), Ollama, llama.cpp, and Custom OpenAI endpoints.
- Dynamic Topic Rotation: Automatically cycles conversation topics (hobbies, likes/dislikes, town gossip, relationships) to keep conversations fresh.
- Responsive UI Experience: Shows immediate animated placeholder dialogue while the AI generates the response in the background, smoothly swapping in the text as soon as it arrives.
- Built-in Mock Mode: Comes with an offline test mode so you can test dialogue boxes in-game without any internet or AI setup.
- Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Integration: Adjust your provider, API key, model name, max tokens, temperature, and custom topics directly from the in-game options menu.
- Runtime Console Commands: Quick controls via SMAPI console:
  * valleyyaps on / valleyyaps off -- Toggle mod on/off.
  * valleyyaps mock / valleyyaps real -- Switch between mock replies and real AI queries.
  * valleyyaps set provider <gemini|ollama|llama.cpp|custom> -- Change provider.
  * valleyyaps set key <api_key> -- Set API key.


Requirements
- SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (v4.0.0+): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- An AI Provider:
  * Free Google Gemini API key (recommended)
  * OR local LLM (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, etc.)
